error[L0100]: a routine that returns nothing is written `-> none`, not `-> ()`

  |                            ^^
  = note: [1800]: a function's returns are named in parentheses, as in `(code: i32)`, or written `none`; empty parentheses name no return
  = help: write `none` after `->`
